overview: October 28-29 was headlined by Kumar Kartikeya Dwivedi's RFC series enabling synchronous callback unwinding in BPF, alongside a new bpf_path_getattr() helper, task work use-after-free fixes, and GCC selftest compatibility improvements from Vineet Gupta. An RCU correctness fix for sleepable bpf_get_stack() and bpftool LLVM disassembler improvements round out the period.

patches.title: bpf: Give a helper a way to call its callback with a pad
patches.author: Kumar Kartikeya Dwivedi
patches.summary: Lead patch of an 11-patch RFC series implementing unwinding for synchronous BPF callbacks. The core idea is to give BPF helpers a 'pad' — extra instruction slots after the helper call — into which a callback can unwind rather than returning normally. This enables early exit from helpers like bpf_loop, bpf_for_each_map_elem, bpf_find_vma, bpf_user_ringbuf_drain, and bpf_rbtree_add, allowing callbacks to propagate error-like conditions back to callers.

patches.title: bpf: Add bpf_path_getattr()
patches.author: Anastasios Papagiannis
patches.summary: Introduces a new BPF helper bpf_path_getattr() that allows BPF programs to query file path attributes from a struct path pointer. This enables tracing and security programs to inspect filesystem paths without needing to walk the dentry chain manually. The series includes documentation and selftests covering the new helper.

patches.title: bpf: Retire task work before reclaiming hash elements
patches.author: Yun Lu
patches.summary: Fixes a use-after-free bug by ensuring that task work is fully retired before BPF hash map elements are reclaimed during deletion. Without this ordering guarantee, an async callback scheduled via task work could fire after the map element it references has been freed. This is the first version of what later became a broader 8-patch series in v2.

patches.title: bpf: Fix suspicious RCU usage for sleepable bpf_get_stack()
patches.author: Feng Yang
patches.summary: Fixes a suspicious RCU usage warning triggered when calling the sleepable variant of bpf_get_stack() from contexts where RCU read-side critical sections are not properly managed. The fix ensures correct RCU semantics in the sleepable path, preventing potential data corruption under preemption. This single patch lays groundwork for the more complete sleepable stack-tracing series submitted on Nov 6.

patches.title: bpftool: Make the LLVM disassembler an optional runtime dependency
patches.author: Mark Korenberg
patches.summary: Second patch of a 2-patch series making bpftool's LLVM disassembler support an optional runtime dependency rather than a hard build requirement. The companion patch also fixes a resource leak in the disposal of the LLVM disassembler context. These changes improve bpftool's portability to systems where LLVM is not installed, while still using it when available.

patches.title: selftests/bpf: libarena: Order equal rbtree keys FIFO
patches.author: Changwoo Min
patches.summary: Lead patch of a 3-patch series improving the arena-based rbtree library used in BPF selftests. The series adds FIFO ordering for equal keys, caches the leftmost node and tree count for O(1) lookups, and adds rb_next() for ordered traversal. These improvements make the arena rbtree suitable for a broader range of benchmark and test scenarios.

patches.title: selftests/bpf: Build callx tests with GCC that defines __BPF_FEATURE_CALLX
patches.author: Vineet Gupta
patches.summary: Lead patch of an 8-patch series (v2) improving BPF selftest compatibility with GCC builds. The series fixes clang-only warning flags leaking into GCC compilations, adds proper SKIP reporting for arena tests that GCC cannot build, rewrites mixed arena/scalar ALU tests in BPF assembly to avoid GCC limitations, and fixes incorrect pass reporting for empty test bodies. These changes make the BPF selftest suite more reliable for non-Clang toolchains.
